title: ::: PSS-OFF 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ Passoff Reading 158 ]

blocks.text: Ethics begins with our being conscious that we choose how we behave. For instance, we can either tell the truth or tell a lie. These two possibilities are presented to us as options. We are capable of doing either one because we can control our actions. A stone, however, does not face this kind of options because it cannot distinguish between different courses of action. A stone can behave only in the way an outside force makes it behave. Unlike a stone, a person can start an action by himself or herself. The difference, then, is that a stone is not conscious of possibilities, whereas human beings are conscious that they face genuine alternatives.
